The new inner should_cancel check converts Authentication to Cancelled, so the shell sees a retryable watchdog timeout instead of its permanent identity refusal.
findings.rationale: The combined attempt stop predicate is not identical to explicit user cancellation. Preserve the existing unique attempt owner's permanent-failure and user-cancellation ordering; a credential refusal must not become retryable merely because a watchdog also expired.

Retain Authentication for the Runner shell to adjudicate after actual user cancellation; ordinary low-level and Memory calls keep cancellation-before-error behavior. Add a causal regression covering real credential refusal, actual watchdog, explicit cancellation, zero transport/tool/checkpoint effects and one terminal attempt.
findings.resolution: Applied private policy forwarding and a cfg(test)-only borrowed post-preparation observer; new actual-shell watchdog/Auth/user-cancel and ordinary cancellation regression is wired into both existing Actions lanes. findings.rationale: Automatic compaction belongs to the admitted worker and is not an independent summary admission. Close this actual consumer in the existing Inference/composition/Session owners before claiming continuity.
findings.required_fix: Provide bound admitted-turn summarization through existing Inference; capture admitted provider, models and bindings in the actual App callback and retain them for both phases. Preserve independent fresh summaries, no-tool/usage/session options and ordinary transport fallback. Authentication or missing-identity Configuration must refuse either compaction phase without committing degraded Session history. Add actual callback/compaction negative controls and real HTTP identity/rotation controls.
findings.resolution: Applied admitted-turn Inference summary entry and the production-used App closure with cloned provider/model/bindings; preserved independent fresh entry, shared usage/Cursor/no-tool implementation and ordinary transport fallback. Both identity-refused phases now stop before Session mutation. Authored actual App compaction and real Codex/Native HTTP oracles; fresh review and exact-H Actions remain pending.
